t.zh: <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>写成规则是 ⟦∃x. ?P(x); ⋀x. ⟦?P(x)⟧ ⟹ ?C⟧ ⟹ ?C。它也是消去规则：第一条前提对上一条「存在」，第二条前提前面的 ⋀x 让新目标多出一样东西 a，以及关于它的已知。
t.en: <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref> as a rule is ⟦∃x. ?P(x); ⋀x. ⟦?P(x)⟧ ⟹ ?C⟧ ⟹ ?C. It is an elimination rule too: its first premise fits a “there is”, and the ⋀x in front of the second gives the new goal a thing a, with a given about it.

brief.zh: 设计一个证明助手，证完每一个目标。
brief.en: Design a proof assistant that proves every goal.

hint.zh: 已知自相矛盾，矛盾在它说存在的那样东西身上。
hint.en: The given contradicts itself, about the thing it says there is.

hint.zh: <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref>接上<part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>，对上「存在」那条已知。
hint.en: <part-ref to="lemma:erule"></part-ref> with <part-ref to="part:exE"></part-ref>, on the “there is” given.
